articles.headline: Meta launches enterprise AI platform, hires MongoDB CEO to lead new initiative
articles.summary: Meta is pushing further into enterprise AI with a new business-focused platform, signaling stronger competition in workplace automation and AI infrastructure. For companies, this could expand the range of enterprise AI options while intensifying pressure on vendors to prove ROI, governance, and integration value.

articles.headline: Is AI killing jobs for college grads? Not yet, new study says
articles.summary: Fresh coverage of the AI-and-jobs debate suggests the immediate labor-market impact for new graduates is still limited, though employers continue to reassess entry-level work. Business leaders should watch this closely because AI adoption is reshaping hiring plans, training budgets, and how companies structure early-career roles.

articles.headline: Salesforce expands AI management layer and integrates Anthropic’s Claude
articles.summary: Salesforce is adding an AI management layer focused on turning trapped data into business value, while also integrating Anthropic’s Claude and new reasoning capabilities. That matters for enterprises because it can affect CRM automation, governance, agent deployment, and the cost structure of AI-enabled workflows.
